why: A class folder's class is defined by the file named after the folder (MATLAB doc 'Class Folders'), and a classdef's name must match its file's: `@vane/VANE.m` defining `classdef vane < Spinner` defines no class `vane` MATLAB knows, so `@vane`'s functions have no class with a superclass, and a call `turn(other, 1)` on a parameter in `@vane/helper.m` is taken for no inherited method of `Spinner` (the caller-class guess, which reads its class's hierarchy, has none here).
